newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy June new car registrations seen rising again.
newsitem.headline: Italy June new car registrations seen rising again.

text.p: Italian new car registrations in June are expected to be around 220,000, a jump of some 50 percent on the same month last year, analysts and auto sector sources said.
In June 1996 new car registrations totalled 147,855.
Italy's Transport Ministry will issue the official data for June on July 10.
May new car registrations rose 43.23 percent year on year to 232,600.
Some analysts said that in June the Italian market would probably be one of the few European car markets to show a positive trend.
They said Italy's car buying incentive scheme was still helping to boost car sales.
Others noted that when forecasting the number of new registrations it was necessary to take into account the bad weather at the start of June which prevented many deliveries.
A heavy hailstorm had in fact damaged some 17,000 foreign manufactured vehicles parked in a car park in Parma, Northern Italy, awaiting delivery to dealers throughout the country.
Auto sector sources said many of these cars had to be sent back to the makers for repair.
